text:
sam: Heads-up: we need a quick docs merge plan for the v3.5 release cutover. Tentative GA Fri Apr 8. I want clear cutoff + merge order so preview builds don't block the release pipeline.

Priya: Suggest docs freeze at Wed Apr 6 12:00 UTC (only critical fixes after). We should also mark which PRs require feature-flag parity before public docs go live.

omar: Current blockers: PR 1420 (versioned migration guide), PR 1427 (embed API examples), PR 1433 (cross-link fixes). 1420 preview shows warnings for deprecated API references.

ci-bot: PR 1420 preview failed  build 3421: broken reference to `/api/old-embed`. Full log: https://staging.builds/3421.

sam: OK prioritize 1420. If migration guide references old endpoints we need either a redirect or an inline note about the FF behavior.

Priya: I'm fine with merging docs that are purely editorial now, but any code samples or API surface changes must pass preview. No `skip-preview` except for tiny wording fixes. I'll maintain the approval list and merge schedule.

omar: I've updated PR 1427 to include JS/Go snippets (Go is new here). Example snippet: `client.Embed(ctx, "text sample")` and a short note about dimensionality change in v3.5.

docs-bot: Queued previews: PR 1420 build 3421 (failed), PR 1427 build 3422 (in progress), PR 1433 build 3423 (queued). Use `/docs-preview rebuild <pr>` to force.

infra-team: For redirects, we can put a temporary HTTP redirect from `/api/old-embed` -> `/api/embeddings` with short TTL to reduce preview flakiness. Need an infra PR: INF-4410. ETA to deploy Tue Apr 5.

sam: Proposed merge order once previews green: 1420 (migration) -> INF-4410 (redirect) -> 1433 (cross-links) -> 1427 (examples). That should minimize broken links on staging.

Priya: I'll assign reviewers: @omar for 1420, @sam for 1427, @infra-team for INF-4410. Also adding `docs-critical` label to 1420 and 1427.

ci-bot: Re-run requested for PR 1420. Build 3424 started.

omar: Quick note: some of the deprecated fields appear only in older model docs. I'm going to add a short compatibility table and a `Note: only applies if FF < emb-v2` callout, so customers know when the migration steps apply.

sam: Good. Also let's publish a small release-note snippet in the release channel to warn integrators about docs changes and planned redirect. I'll wait until previews are green.

docs-bot: Build 3424 (PR 1420) succeeded.

infra-team: INF-4410 is open and review requested. Routing change ready for canary once approved.

Priya: With build green, I'll merge 1420 after one more review. Plan to merge INF-4410 right after infra approval, then re-trigger previews for 1427/1433.

omar: If redirects come late we can still merge examples but gate publish with `publish_date` in the docs frontmatter so they don't go live until April 8. That way we decouple merge order from public visibility.

sam: Excellent idea. Use `publish_date` for 1427 if needed. Add a short checklist item to the PR template: "set publish_date if merge must precede infra change".

Priya: Finalizing: freeze Wed Apr 6 12:00 UTC, merge order 1420 -> INF-4410 -> 1433 -> 1427, no skip-preview for code/API changes, use `publish_date` to control actual exposure where necessary. I'll post the schedule in #release and tag reviewers now.

sam: Thanks team — feel free to ping me for escalations. :rocket:
